name: Freedom
subtitle: Fifteen seconds, from a seven and an eleven. Then walk out free.
signs: Each lock opens only for the exact time it shows. There is no timer here, only water clocks. Press H if you get stuck.
Press E on a lock to start it, and E again to stop it. Within 1 second counts.
The water left behind is time you can still spend.
The last door opens only if you owe no time. Repay at the Archive, then walk out free.

locks.title: Lock: measure 7 seconds using a 7s water clock.

guide.text: Flip the 7s clock (press E beside it).
Step to the lock and press E to START it.
When the clock shows EMPTY!, press E on the lock to STOP it.

locks.title: Lock: measure 15 seconds using a 7s and an 11s water clock.

guide.text: Flip BOTH clocks: the 7s on the left and the 11s on the right.
Stand at the lock. When the 7s clock shows EMPTY!, press E to START.
4 seconds later (11 - 7) the 11s clock shows EMPTY!. Flip it again at once.
When the 11s clock shows EMPTY! again (4 + 11 = 15), press E to STOP.
